astronomy_picture_of_the_day.title: The Dark Wolf Nebula
astronomy_picture_of_the_day.explanation: A dark wolf lies in gum. No, this isn’t a riddle! Today's image features the Dark Wolf Nebula (Sandqvist–Lindroos 17), a spooky dust cloud embedded within the Gum 55 (RCW 113) Nebula in the Scorpius constellation.
